title: Toriko
synopsis: In the world where the taste and texture of food are very important there is Toriko, a hunter of precious foods regularly hired by restaurants and the rich. A man with inhuman skills to capture the ferocious, evasive and rare animals to complete his ultimate dinner course and then the chef Komatsu, his current accomplice: a weak timid person who was inspired by Toriko's greatness and accompanies him on all his journeys on his quest for the course of his life.

episodes.title: Landing, Gourmet Island! The Gourmet Hunter Toriko Appears!
episodes.synopsis: Chef Komatsu requested Gourmet Hunter, Toriko, to capture a Galala Gator for a party. While searching for the beast, they noticed the island's inhabitants were all acting out of place, as if chasen out. The Gator they were after wasn't what they'd imagined, but something twice as dangerous.

episodes.title: The Undiscovered Giant Beast! Toriko, Capture a Gararagator!
episodes.synopsis: Special shown at the Jump Super Anime Tour in 2010.

episodes.title: The Well Mellowed 7-Colored Fruit Juice! Pick the Rainbow Fruit!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko is commissioned by the International Gourmet Organization (IGO) to obtain the Rainbow Fruit, which is guarded by powerful Troll Kongs (four-armed large gorillas) in an enclosed sanctuary area called a Biotope. News reporter Tina follows Toriko and Komatsu through the biotope wall to try and get footage of Toriko in action. Toriko encounters a Troll Kong scout and immobilizes it with a stun gun, although he gets licked by its tongue. Toriko soon encounters more Troll Kongs but it becomes a chore to try to take all of them out. When the rain washes off the underling's scent, Toriko uses his intimidation ability and scares the Kong leader to surrender. Toriko takes a single fruit, however Tina is caught by IGO authorities and her footage is confiscated. Moved by the ever-changing flavors of the Rainbow Fruit, served in a jelly by Komatsu, Toriko declares the Rainbow Fruit as the dessert for his Full Course Menu. Meanwhile, various shady figures become interested in Toriko's movements.

episodes.title: Prepare It! The Poisonous Puffer Whale! The Heavenly King Coco Appears!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's team and the Strawhat Crew of One Piece meet again, only this time they also meet Goku and the Dragonball Z Fighters!

episodes.title: The Deadly Cave Battle! Fire, Five-Fold Spiked Punch!
episodes.synopsis:
Toriko receives an important assignment from the IGO; he is to accompany Biotope head chief Ayame and find the special hidden menu detailing the full-course meal of the legendary Bishokushin Acacia.

The quest to uncover the secret of the special menu takes Toriko, Ayame, Komatsu, Zebra, Sunny and Coco through the dangerous Hungry Triangle to eventually land on the island known as “Acacia's Kitchen”. On the island they discover a bounty beyond anything they couldn't have imagined; rare species of animals, Regal Mammoths, terrifying monsters, strange ruins and a giant refrigerator.

Toriko and Ayame explore the ruins where they are confronted by Girim, the former Bishokukai Special Cooking Adviser. Even crazier, the 3 sous chefs and a new GT Robo step in, turning the situation into an all out battle!

episodes.title: The Knocking Master! Time to Taste the Puffer Whale!
episodes.synopsis: After eating the Hungry-la Bird that they captured, Luffy and Toriko team up again to save Nami and Komatsu who have been kidnapped by the Cocoalas.

episodes.title: The Strongest Wolf That Ever Lived! The Battle Wolf is Reborn!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, the legendary Gourmet Hunter, is hired by timid chef Komatsu to help track down a delicious Gararagator for a very important dinner. Will the intrepid adventures taste sweet success - or become their dinner's dinner?

episodes.title: The Threat Appears! Rumble at the Gourmet Coliseum!
episodes.synopsis: The International Gourmet Organization hires Toriko to harvest the legendary Rainbow Fruit, but the famed hunter will have to prove he's tougher than an entire nest of Troll Kongs before he can finish the job!

episodes.title: That Which Is Passed Down! Activate, Gourmet Cells!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu set out to capture a Puffer Whale, but this daring quest to satisfy their exotic appetites may be the death of them both! Lucky for them, King Coco is along for the ride!

episodes.title: The Man Who Has an Invincible Domain! His Name Is Sunny!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu is kidnapped by a gourmet hunter who wants to use the boy as bait. Toriko and Coco are his only hope for survival, but they've got their hands full battling a deadly Devil Python!

episodes.title: Regal Isle Dash! Search for the Jewel Meat!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu finds himself face-to-face with a Devil Python, and the secret weapon Toriko gave him might get the young chef killed! Even if he survives, a daunting task lies ahead: removing the poison from a priceless Puffer Whale!

episodes.title: The Devils' Game! Clear the Devils' Playground!
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the emergence of a horrifying new breed of evil, Toriko and Komatsu are hired by the IGO to track down the elusive and delicious Regal Mammoth and its priceless Jewel Meat!

episodes.title: The Ultimate Backup! Clash, Coco Vs. GT Robot!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's epic rumble with the legendary Battle Wolf is derailed by an unexpected new arrival and the interference of an insanely evil representative of the Gourmet Corp!

episodes.title: The Threat Of Deadly Poison! Coco's Formula for Victory!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko fights and defeats the GT Robo. He then adapts the baby battle wolf as his pet, which he names Terry Cloth. Mansam tells Komatsu about Gourmet Cells but does not provide any more details. The Bishoku-kai are revealed to be after the Regal Mammoth as well. At the end the group has a feast (Mansam's Full Course).

episodes.title: The Unyielding Aesthetic! Sunny's Manly Battle!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and the gang are on the hunt for a Regal Mammoth when they cross paths with the Heavenly King, Sunny. With GT Robots on the prowl and Rock Drums dead ahead, they'll need Sunny's help to survive!

episodes.title: Rin's Final Wish! Awaken, Super Toriko!
episodes.synopsis: While the villainous GT Robots continue their search for mammoth meat, Toriko has his hands full battling an ornery Obasaurus, and Komatsu learns the powerful secrets of the Gourmet Cells.

episodes.title: Super Toriko, the Fists of Anger! This Is the Strongest Spike Punch!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's daring attempt to navigate the Devils' Playground brings him face-to-face with a Soldier Frog, an Axeox, and an Avian Beast with hallucinogenic breath! Meanwhile, a GT Robot stalks the Regal Mammoth.

episodes.title: The Taste Written in His DNA! Toriko, Search for the BB Corn!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's quick thinking saves Sunny and Komatsu from being crush by a mammoth, but there are greater threats looming. A giant GT Robot is ready to rumble, and the Gourmet Hunters are all out of strength.

episodes.title: The Talent of Battle! Show Me, Terry, King in the Making!
episodes.synopsis: While Toriko searches for the priceless Jewel Meat, Sunny and Coco wage separate battles against deadly GT Robots! Will Sunny's hair leash and Coco's poison rifle be enough secure victory?

episodes.title: For Terry's Sake! Burst By Broiling Heat, BB Corn!
episodes.synopsis: Sunny's battle with the GT Robot is complicated by the arrival of a Mega Octopus, and something extremely evil hunts Toriko and his famished friends!

episodes.title: The Gourmet Corp. Assassin! The Moment Toriko's Techniques Evolve!
episodes.synopsis: Rin's tragic end sends Toriko into a rage, but the price of fueling his passionate attack may cost him his life. Meanwhile, Komatsu takes a heroic stand when the GT Robot tries to rob the chef of his favorite knife!

episodes.title: Pressure of Madness! Grinpatch vs. Toriko!
episodes.synopsis: A bite of the delicious Jewel Meat energizes Toriko, who uses a vicious Ten-Fold Spike Punch to put the hurt on a GT Robot! When the dust finally settles on the battlefield, dinner will be served!

episodes.title: The Amusement Park of Eating! The Bellyfull City, Gourmet Town!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu must find an exquisite sauce to top a dish of very rare fish, and Toriko prepares to venture deep into the deadly Wu Jungle in search of food fit for a Battle Wolf!

episodes.title: Dreamtime! Setsuno's Century Soup!
episodes.synopsis: Time is running out for Komatsu to complete his fishy dish, and Toriko watches as Terry faces off against a beastly Zombie Wood. Will the Battle Wolf show his true power - or fall to his ferocious foe?

episodes.title: Meeting at the Saloon! Rivalry Between Gourmet Hunters!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Terry finally find the deliciously elusive BB Corn, and Komatsu must depend on a special blend of spices to survive an encounter with a giant lizard!

episodes.title: Challenge of the Gourmet Hunter Army! Disembarking at Freezing Hell!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko must take his powers to the next level if he hopes to defeat a ravenous assassin from the Gourmet Corps. Elsewhere, Komatsu learns of the legendary ingredient with the power to stop - or start - wars!

episodes.title: Hurry While It's Hot! A Survival Race on Ice!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko continues his battle with the corn-stealing, straw-wielding villain known as Grinpatch, and Komatsu desperately races to make it home before a rare dish of fish becomes nothing more than bubbles!

episodes.title: The Explosive Fire Shakes Ice Mountain! The Identity of the Masked Man!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu travel to the city of culinary dreams for a special dinner with a living gourmet legend! Elsewhere, the sinister Gourmet Corps reveal the secrets behind their desperate desire for the Jewel Meat!

episodes.title: Glorious Bug Tamer! Tommyrod vs Toriko
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu and Toriko are treated to an ultra-exclusive tour of Setsuno's kitchen, including the top secret area where she prepares Century Soup! Inspired, they set off in search of the genuine article, but trouble lies ahead!

episodes.title: Gratitude and Pride! Takimaru's Full-Out Corkscrew Shot!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and a ravenous army of Gourmet Hunters set off in search of the legendary Century Soup. Their journey will take them to Ice Hell, but they'll have to survive a Sharkrocodile attack to arrive in one piece!

episodes.title: Settled! Match and Takimaru's Desperate Attacks!
episodes.synopsis: Tundra Dragons and killer icicles are just a few of the obstacles standing between Toriko and the Century Soup. If the elements don't kill him, there is a mean, green, GT Robot waiting to finish the job!

episodes.title: The Gourmet Reviver and the Legendary Soup's Location!
episodes.synopsis: Zonge stumbles upon a group of angry Growlruses, Toriko and company go head-to-head with a herd of ferocious Freezer Bison, and a villainous vice chef unleashes an army of beastly insects!

episodes.title: Head-on Fight! Fierce Battle! Toriko vs. Tommyrod!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu team up to turn a deadly Silver Grizzly into a scrumptious soup. A villainous member of the Gourmet Corps is hot on their trail, but help is on the way in the form of a Heavenly King!

episodes.title: Ultimate Desperation! Tommyrod's Full-Power Mode Explodes!
episodes.synopsis: When Toriko's hand is frozen solid during a deadly encounter with a Gourmet Corps bug tamer, the burden of collecting the Century Soup falls squarely on the small shoulders of Komatsu! Is the little chef up to such a big task?

episodes.title: Wondrous Power! Gourmet Reviver Teppei Joins the Battle!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko fights to survive a deadly swarm of insects, and Takimaru fights for his life against an unbreakable opponent. Meanwhile, Komatsu's quest to collect the Century Soup is monitored by GT Robot!

episodes.title: The Last Drop! Who Will Get the Century Soup?!
episodes.synopsis: Takimaru relies on lessons from his past to settle the score with his flexible foe, and Match puts his blade to the ultimate test against an opponent clad in Crash Turtle armor!

episodes.title: Farewell, Ice Hell! Granny Setsu's Hidden Power!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko heats things up in a heroic attempt to end the insect onslaught! Elsewhere, Komatsu finally reaches the location of the Century Soup - only to find that there is no soup!

episodes.title: Splendid Healing! Here Comes the Gourmet Reviver, Yosaku!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko attempts to end his epic battle with Tommyrod by unleashing a Thirteen-Fold Spike Punch, but the bug tamer counters by revealing the true depths of his devious strength!

episodes.title: Race to Finish! Will It Be Toriko's Recovery, or Komatsu's Soup?!
episodes.synopsis: The sudden arrival of a powerful Gourmet Reviver prompts Tommyrod to shed his skin, giving birth to a monstrous Parasite Emperor! The buggy beast is big and bad, but will he survive a bout with Hellboros, the ruler of Ice Hell?

episodes.title: To the World of Ultimate Bliss! Taste the Century Soup!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu is crushed by his failure to capture the Century Soup, but Teppei has one more amazing trick up his sleeve. With evil forces bearing down on them, will any our heroes live to tell of their adventure?!

episodes.title: Housewarming Party! Everyone Gather at the Sweets House!
episodes.synopsis: After being rescued by Granny Setsu, the weary and wounded adventures set a course for the healing country known as Life. Toriko has an arm to regenerate, and Komatsu is eager to recreate the Century Soup!

episodes.title: The Gourmet King Championship! Search for the Ultimate Sweets!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's gang arrives in the healing country of Life, an amazing land of curative creatures that can treat almost any ailment. After a chance meeting with Sunny, the group visits Teppei's master, a renowned - and rowdy - Reviver.

episodes.title: Bonding Dish! Partners Are Forever!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's recovery progresses faster than expected, but the strain of growing a new arm may cost him his life. Meanwhile, Komatsu struggles to find the final ingredient for his Century Soup!

episodes.title: White Hot! Toriko vs. the IGO President!
episodes.synopsis: With the help of an unusual ingredient, Komatsu finally completes the Century Soup! Thanks to the little chef's big accomplishment, Toriko may get his arm back - and add an ingredient to his Full Course Menu of Life!

episodes.title: Vegetable Garden in the Heavens! Vegetable Sky!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko returns home only to discover that his house has been eaten! Looks like it's time to call the candy architect and start gathering delicious ingredients for a new place to rest his head!

episodes.title: Discovery! The King of Vegetables, Ozone Grass!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Sunny, and Coco set out on a death-defying quest to see who can track down the most irresistible sweets for a starving Seven-Colored Nellie!

episodes.title: Confession in the Heavens! The Formation of the Invincible Duo!
episodes.synopsis: Sharkbox Turtles, Honey Dragons, and a Chomp Urchin plague the Heavenly Kings in their mission to feed the Seven-Colored Nellie. Can they survive this perilous quest and satisfy the starving beast?

episodes.title: Shocking Encounter! A Mysterious Life Form Appears!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko tests out his new battle techniques - and his brand new arm - in a ferocious fistfight with the IGO President! Though his strength has improved, Toriko will need more training before he's ready for the Gourmet World!

episodes.title: Toriko Rushes In! The Truth of the Gourmet World!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko begins his training with a mission to collect the delicious Ozone Grass. Komatsu is along for the ride, but is the little chef ready for brutal battles against Flying Sea Lions, Air Gorillas, and a Killer Bean Tree!?

episodes.title: Enter the Astounding Ringer! The True Meaning of a Partner!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu continue their quest to collect the Ozone Grass, but their journey only grows more difficult. Before they arrive at the garden in the sky, they must pass through a deadly thunderstorm!

episodes.title: The Reunion of Toriko and Luffy! Find the Seafood Fruit!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu finally reach the Ozone Grass, but the legendary ingredient proves challenging to harvest. As the culinary adventurers struggle to satisfy their appetites, something sinister watches the scene unfold!

episodes.title: Shock! The Broken Kitchen Knife and Cutler Melk!
episodes.synopsis: Before completing their mission to capture the Ozone Grass, Toriko and Komatsu encounter an unusual beast that's identical to a GT Robot. What is this new menace, and what does it want?

episodes.title: Tension! Toriko's Knife vs. Melk's Kitchen Knife!
episodes.synopsis: Eager to test his new abilities in the Gourmet World, Toriko ignores the warnings of his closest friends and goes in search of adventure! Meanwhile, Komatsu is shocked by an unexpected visitor!

episodes.title: Supergravity! Conquer Heavy Hole!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's expedition into the Gourmet World proves more dangerous than he expected, but luckily, someone back home is looking out for him. Will it be enough to keep him alive?

episodes.title: Hidden Truth! The First Melk Appears!
episodes.synopsis: When Komatsu breaks his favorite knife, he and Toriko set out to find a famed craftsman who is said to forge the strongest blades imaginable. Their journey - plagued by Rock Wolves and Scale Kongs - will not be easy.

episodes.title: Debut! The Second Generation's Succession and Melk Stardust!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are shocked by who they find waiting at the home of Cutler Melk, and the legendary Gourmet Hunter's brash nature quickly leads to a knife fight!

episodes.title: A Work Made with All Her Might! The Completed Melk Knife!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu spends some quality time with Cutler Melk's apprentice, and Toriko delves deeper into the depths of Heavy Hole, where the gravity is intense and the Barbamoths are fierce!

episodes.title: Super Celeb! Once-in-a-Lifetime Gourmet Carriage Journey!
episodes.synopsis: The intense gravity of Heavy Hole pushes Toriko's body to the breaking point. Back on the surface, Komatsu makes a shocking discovery about Culter Melk's apprentice!

episodes.title: Finally, He Appears! The Last of the Four Kings, Zebra!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko delves into the various mysterious of Cutler Melk, including his unusual voice, and Komatsu uses his culinary skills to give Melk's apprentice a confidence boost!

episodes.title: Unleashed Roar! Death Row Zebra's Release!
episodes.synopsis: While Melk's apprentice works tirelessly to craft a special knife for Komatsu, the little chef and Toriko wait eagerly for the job to be finished - and the feast to begin!

episodes.title: Warning! Zebra Has Disembarked at the Sand Garden!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu take a trip on the luxurious Gourmet Carriage, but there's more to this vacation than sight-seeing and fine food. The adventurous duo is headed for the gates of hell!

episodes.title: Komatsu Disappears! Devilish Desert Labyrinth!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu explore the despicable depths of Honey Prison as they make their way to the one called Zebra. Dare they hope to survive such a deafening encounter!?

episodes.title: The Sealed Voice! The Other-Dimensional Gourmet Pyramid!
episodes.synopsis: The one they call Zebra is released from prison just in time for Monster Season and a showdown with the horrifying Forrest Goblin! After he eats lunch, of course!

episodes.title: Astounding! The Mysterious Ancient Manuscript and the Creature Inside the Coffin!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu voices his concerns about travelling with such a dangerous criminal, and Zebra makes some new friends after a slugfest with a savage scorpion!

episodes.title: Shocking Showdown! Salamander Sphinx!
episodes.synopsis: A dangerous encounter with Desert Sharks leads to Komatsu's disappearance, which leads Toriko and Zebra to the foot of the Gourmet Pyramid!

episodes.title: Cooperative Cooking! Komatsu Manages Toriko and Zebra!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu is trapped within the labyrinthine Gourmet Pyramid, and only Zebra and Toriko can save him. Unfortunately, a deadly Gorgonclops and a hideous Unicorn Cerberus are standing in their way!

episodes.title: Explosion of Combination Techniques! We Get the World's Best Cola!
episodes.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko must eat everything in their path in order to regain the strength needed for their daring rescue mission! Meanwhile, Komatsu struggles to survive on his own!

episodes.title: The Truth Revealed! Komatsu's Will and the Identity of the Mysterious Creature!
episodes.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko finally reunite with Komatsu, but their troubles are only just beginning. To acquire the Mellow Cola, they must defeat a ferocious Salamander Sphinx, but they have no idea how to kill it!

episodes.title: Surpass Dad! Midsummer Gobbling Katsu Curry!
episodes.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko carry out Komatsu’s brutal orders as the little chef tells them exactly how to harvest the Mellow Cola. Their mission is on the verge of success when an unseen evil emerges!

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind! Superb Gobbling Katsu Curry!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Zebra must work together to defeat the mysterious monster that attacked Komatsu. There's just one problem: the two warriors are completely out of energy!

episodes.title: New Phase! Toriko's Decision and the Reunion with "Him"!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu must find the courage to stand up to Zebra and tell the truth about who he wants to be his partner. Later, the horrifying identity of the mysterious monster from the Gourmet Pyramid is finally revealed!

episodes.title: Food Luck Runneth Over! Pilgrimage to the Gourmet Shrine!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's trip to the beach turns into an adventure when he agrees to help his favorite curry shop track down some much needed - and very dangerous - ingredients! First on the list: Water Tiger!

episodes.title: Uwaaa! Astonishing Stun Apple!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko continues his heated battle with powerful Water Tiger, and Komatsu helps a heartbroken chef find the amazing curry cooking skills locked inside him!

episodes.title: Chicken Beast's Egg! The Memories of Old Man Yocchi and His Wife!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's quest to get stronger leads the dynamic culinary duo to a remote cafe in the middle of a jet black lake. The food is fantastic, but the clientele is deadly!

episodes.title: Glittering Crystal! Shining Gourami!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu visit the legendary Gourmet Shrine where they seek to increase their food luck! After sampling many delicacies and taking in the sights, Komatsu takes center stage for a surprising feat of strength!

episodes.title: Shocking Rapids! Giant Waterfall, Death Falls!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu hope to have the element of surprise on their side as they travel to the explosive Battle Island in search of the legendary Stun Apple!

episodes.title: Sunny's New Attack! The Result of Gorgeous Training!
episodes.synopsis: After his recent lottery win, Komatsu wants to buy Toriko a gift. There's just one problem. The legendary gourmet hunter has his heart set on a priceless piece of land where the Chicken Beast lays its eggs!

episodes.title: Thirty Times Combo! Thirty-Six-Fold Twin Spiked Punch!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Sunny embark on a hair-raising quest to track down the Shining Gourami, an extremely rare sea creature that lives deep within Death Falls!

episodes.title: Cooking by Intuition! Komatsu and the Shining Gourami!
episodes.synopsis: As the quest for the Shining Gourami continues, Toriko grows more and more impressed with Sunny's training. An unexpected battle with a Hippo Shark gives the rainbow-haired gourmet hunter a chance to show off his strength!

episodes.title: Flashy Presentation! Supreme Service With a Meal!
episodes.synopsis: The devastating power of Death Falls sends Sunny into a flashback where he reflects on the days spent battling beasts and honing his instincts on the Road of Three Hells!

episodes.title: Supreme Chitose Ame! Komatsu and Yun's Tale!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Sunny must team up for a powerful combination move that's their only hope for surviving the journey through Death Falls! But even if they reach the other side, they'll need help to capture their prey.

episodes.title: Assemble on Autumn Mountain! Terry, Yun, Kiss, Queen!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu takes center stage as the little chef struggles to unlock the secret to preparing the Shining Gourami! Toriko and Sunny are exhausted and hungry, and Komatsu must listen to his ingredients if he wants to feed his friends!

episodes.title: Reunion! Take-chan of Fairytale Castle!
episodes.synopsis: When Melk the Second needs help finishing a very special knife, Toriko and Komatsu compete in a prestigious competition in an attempt to win the final ingredient needed to complete her project!

episodes.title: Crossroads! A Chef's Destination!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are asked to track down the ingredients for a very special batch of candy, but the most unlikely of heroes ends up saving the day!

episodes.title: Dramatic Transformation! Hair Salon Barber Gourmet!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Coco, and Sunny race to see who'll be first to capture a delicious Supear, but their adventure takes a dangerous turn when Komatsu is abducted by Mutton Boars!

episodes.title: Gathering of the Four Kings! A Midwinter Night's Miracle!
episodes.synopsis: A sinister force is abducting the top chefs in the world, and an old friend of Komatsu’s may be in great danger! Elsewhere, Toriko and Coco attempt to capture a rare appetizer!

episodes.title: Merry Feastmas! Gourmet Santa's Present!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu is shocked by the lack of culinary honor exhibited by his old friend. Meanwhile, Toriko and Coco team up to open a giant treasure chest - but what they find inside leaves them baffled!

episodes.title: Heaven or Hell!? Storming Into the Gourmet Casino!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu reunite for some much needed rest and relaxation at a gourmet barber shop. The food is superb, but their hair may never recover!

episodes.title: Enter: The Boss of the Underground Cooking World, Livebearer!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Sunny, Coco, and Komatsu brave frigid temperatures and Bison Frogs as they search for a legendary tree that's entirely edible!

episodes.title: Life and Death Card Game! Gourmet Tasting!
episodes.synopsis: Chief recruits Toriko and the whole gang to help spread tasty Christmas cheer to hungry kids across the world! Even Zebra manages a good deed by mistake, and the holiday ends with a delicious miracle!

episodes.title: Dead Heat! Coco vs. Livebearer
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco venture into the Pleasure Zone on quest to track down some extremely rare Meteor Garlic, but they soon cross paths with an old friend who could use their help!

episodes.title: Coco's Gambit! The Ingredients That Determine Victory or Defeat!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and the gang make a splash at the casino as they attempt to win enough cash and ingredients to be gain admittance to the VIP area, but what lies ahead could prove deadly!

episodes.title: Eat or Be Eaten! Toriko vs. Hannya Panda!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco go head-to-head with Livebearer in a game of Gourmet Memory that could cost the loser all their memories of ever eating food!

episodes.title: Climax! The Last, Most Terrible Ingredients!
episodes.synopsis: Coco and Livebearer continue their epic showdown, but Toriko does most of the heavy lifting, devouring a mountain of pudding and handful of acorns as hard as bullets!

episodes.title: The Moment of Truth! Coco's Daring Scenario!
episodes.synopsis: The deadly game unfolding between Coco and Livebearer reaches an unprecedented level of danger as Toriko must face off against a fearsome Hanya Panda to avoid the agony of defeat!

episodes.title: A Taste That's out of This World! Eating the Meteor Garlic!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's slugfest with the Hanya Panda proves to be more brutal than expected, and even if he survives, the difference between victory and defeat may ultimately lie with Komatsu!

episodes.title: Showdown at the Summit! Ichiryu vs. Midora of the Gourmet Corp.!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko keeps his team in the game by surviving mouthfuls of Shock Lemons and Nitro Cherries, but if Livebearer can withstand a bite of poison potato - all will be lost!

episodes.title: Hidden Training Ingredient! Emergency Instruction from Ichiryu!
episodes.synopsis: The true genius of Coco's plan is finally revealed as Livebearer finds himself unable to eat the poison potato, but the memory-devouring madman won't go down without a fight!

episodes.title: Run, Strongest Army! Toriko, Luffy, and Goku!
episodes.synopsis: Komatsu gets help preparing the Meteor Garlic from a very unexpected source, and Granny Setsu is paid a visit by the IGO!

episodes.title: The Four Kings Assemble to Mark the 100th Episode!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko searches for more training ingredients, Komatsu impresses his boss with dazzling new cooking techniques, and Ichiryu comes face-to-face with an old nemesis!

episodes.title: Toriko Faints in Agony?! Capture the World's Stinkiest Ingredient!
episodes.synopsis: Before beginning the search for his next training ingredient, Toriko must defeat a ferocious Devil Planet Horse and then dine with a fortune telling sushi chef!

episodes.title: Too Huge! The Giant Fortune Roll, Completed with a Pro Wrestling Move!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Coco, Sunny, Zebra, and Komatsu compete to see who'll be the first to snag the ultra-rare delicacy known as Madam Fish! Winner gets the first bite!

episodes.title: Put Your Hands Together and Bow! Gourmet National Treasure, Chin Chin-Chin, Appears!
episodes.synopsis: In search of the ingredients for a special sushi roll, Toriko and Komatsu travel to an island where the animals are drunk, and it rains champagne! But that's not all. They must also track down a funky fruit with a horrendous smell!

episodes.title: People Without Gratitude Aren't Welcome! Terrifying Chowlin Temple!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu visit an old friend who might be able to help them gather the seaweed they need to complete their epic Fortune Roll!

episodes.title: Toriko Totally Defeated?! The Delicate and Dynamic Power of Honoring the Food!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu try to eat their way to destiny by devouring Monchy's Fortune Roll, but they soon get distracted by a vanishing restaurant!

episodes.title: Gratitude Is What Counts! The Secret to Honoring the Food!
episodes.synopsis: The legendary Chowlin Temple holds the ingredient sought by Toriko and Komatsu, but the adventurous eaters might not be ready for the teachings of the temple's Master!

episodes.title: Approaching Threat! Hurry, Toriko! The Path to the Bubble Fruit!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko's quest to attain the elusive Bubble Fruit hits a snag when he must fight a surprisingly formidable foe. If the gourmet hunter wants to complete his quest, he must learn to honor the food!

episodes.title: Tragedy! The End of Chowlin Temple! Farewell, Komatsu!
episodes.synopsis: Before they can truly honor the food, Toriko and Komatsu must master the art of gratitude by completing a series of tasks that prove far more difficult than originally expected!

episodes.title: Unrivaled Strength! The One Who Mastered Honoring the Food!
episodes.synopsis: His training complete, Toriko embarks on a lengthy journey to capture the Bubble Fruit! Meanwhile, back at Chowlin Temple, something evil approaches!

episodes.title: National Treasure Class One Stroke 100 Million Yen Technique! Toriko vs. Granny Chiyo!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko pushes himself to the breaking point on his hunt for the Bubble Fruit, and a Gourmet Corp. raiding party wreaks havoc at Chowlin Temple!

episodes.title: The Legendary Ingredient, "Center"! Ichiryu and the Strongest Biotope, 0!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko uses his new technique - and the strength he gained by eating the Bubble Fruit - to easily destroy a giant green monster, but the Master of Chowlin Temple may not be so lucky!

episodes.title: Legendary Bee, Infinibee! Toriko vs. New-Style GT Robot!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko shows off an awesome array of powerful new techniques in his battle with Granny Chiyo, but the arrival of a mysterious and terrifying GT Robot puts their bout on hold!

episodes.title: Showing His True Ability! A Taste of Komatsu's Honoring the Food!
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected visitor uses a dangerous technique in an attempt to heal Master Chin-Chin, and the strongest warriors from the IGO gather for dinner - and to prepare for war!

episodes.title: The Four Kings Assemble! The Gourmet World Monsters, the Four-Beasts, Awaken!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are sent to search for Golden Wheat, but their mission is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying and powerful new GT Robot!

episodes.title: A Battle with the Existence of the Human Race on the Line! The Four-Beasts vs. the Four Kings!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko shocks the GT Robot with his amazing strength, and Komatsu gets an assignment from Granny Setsu that will put his powers of Honoring the Food to the ultimate test!

episodes.title: Toriko, Coco, Sunny, Zebra! The Four Kings' Storming Onslaught!
episodes.synopsis: The Four Heavenly Kings share a mega meal together, Komatsu learns the secret to preparing Bubble Fruit, and the human world braces for the arrival of the Four-Beasts!

episodes.title: Toriko's New Crisis! The Creeping Main Body of the Four-Beasts!
episodes.synopsis: Humanity watches in horror as the Four-Beasts easily destroy the military's strongest weapons, but all hope is not lost - the Heavenly Kings are about to join the fight!

episodes.title: The Four-Beasts' Shocking Combined Form and Green Rain!
episodes.synopsis: The Four Heavenly Kings use every attack in their arsenal to survive their battle with the Four-Beasts, but there's a surprise in store for our heroes that could prove fatal!

episodes.title: The Four Kings' Toughest Predicament! Komatsu's Resolve!
episodes.synopsis: Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra appear to have the upper hand in their battle with the Four-Beasts, but the monster's main body is about to wreak havoc on civilization!

episodes.title: Save Humankind with Miraculous Gourmet Luck!
episodes.synopsis: While Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra battle the monstrous Four-Beasts, Komatsu rushes to make an edible antidote to the toxic Green Rain that's drenching the city!
